subject: the 8 Phase272 'lost by guidance' items (evaluation/phase272/ab-untouched-firstrun.json lostByGuidance: 1 value, 7 findings) and EX-11
definitionAudited: scripts/phase272-ab-extraction.mjs: an item is 'lost' when arm A or arm E matched it (including exploratory leads) and neither B nor C did
method: re-read of the committed first-run records (private full copy) and per-item re-observation on the frozen arm-B build c206c9a with the live store's plan (digests equal evaluation/phase272/plans-frozen-known.json); developer audit, not independent; reasons are paraphrased, no page text
headline: 0 of 8 were found by arm A (the existing reader); all 8 were reached only by arm E. 4 are scoring artefacts; 4 are genuine guided-pass effects (a clause linked to a wrong taught outcome, then dropped as a duplicate finding).

items.evidence: the reader emits two leads with this value and unit for the same product (one in a table block, one in a prose block); the scorer addendum counts identical (value, unit, subject) leads once, so only one of the two same-value gold items (ap-q10, ap-q13) can match
arm E's credit is a lead from a feature bullet about which foods can be cooked; it shares only the word 'cook' with the gold dimension (cooking speed); no arm records the speed finding
arm E's credit is a lead from a summary sentence about cooking-test results, matched through the word 'cooking'; B/C link that sentence to taught outcomes instead; no arm records the speed finding
arm E's credit is a lead from a list of cooking functions, matched through the word 'cooking'; no arm records the speed finding
the clause on sensor reaction speed is linked by the plan to a taught odour outcome; the untaught dimension never becomes an exploratory lead

sentences about the companion app's information are linked by the plan to quiet night operation and to room coverage; the per-(dimension, direction, subject) de-duplication then drops them; no exploratory lead

a specification list of fan speeds and mode names is linked to quiet night operation through a mode name; dropped as a duplicate; the gold item itself rests on a specification list (weak as a tester finding)

a taught dimension: the whole sentence links to dialogue clarity, but the reader splits it at a contrast word and the short clause links to fast-motion clarity through the word 'clear'; dropped as a duplicate

consequences: the Phase272 phrase 'lost by guidance' overstates a loss against the existing reader: none of the 8 was found by arm A
four losses are real: plan linking can capture a clause for a wrong taught outcome, and de-duplication hides the capture; this is the same mechanism family as the F2 false positives (EX-12, EX-13)
exploratory credit by single-word overlap is too lenient to count as recall; it should be reported as a lead count only
